subject: german
promptStrong: Give me a 40-word writing task in German on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, then mark my answer for accuracy and range.
promptWeak: Give me a two-way translation drill (German↔English) on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, with answers and the common mistakes to avoid.

questions.explain: 'Der Heiligabend' is 'Christmas Eve' (24 December); 'Silvester' is New Year's Eve.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'We celebrate Christmas with the family'?
options: Wir feiern Weihnachten mit der Familie
Wir vermeiden Weihnachten mit der Familie
questions.explain: 'Feiern' = 'to celebrate' and 'mit der Familie' = 'with the family', so this is correct.
'Berühmt' means 'famous', e.g. 'Er ist berühmt für seine Musik' = 'He is famous for his music'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I would rather go to the mountains'?
options: Ich fahre selten in die Berge
Ich fahre lieber in die Berge
Ich fahre nie in die Berge
questions.explain: 'Lieber' means 'rather/preferably', so 'Ich fahre lieber in die Berge' = 'I'd rather go to the mountains'.

questions.q: What does 'Ich interessiere mich für Musik' mean?
questions.explain: 'Sich interessieren für' means 'to be interested in', so this is 'I am interested in music'.

questions.q: How do you say 'We spent the holidays by the sea'?
options: Wir haben die Ferien am Meer gebraucht
Wir haben die Ferien in den Bergen verbracht
Wir haben die Ferien am Meer verbracht
Wir verbringen die Ferien am Meer
questions.explain: 'Am Meer' = 'by the sea' and 'verbracht' (perfect of 'verbringen') = 'spent'; 'gebraucht' (needed) is the trap.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I prefer to watch series on my phone'?
options: Ich höre Serien lieber auf dem Handy
Ich sehe Filme lieber auf dem Handy
Ich sehe Serien lieber auf dem Handy
Ich sehe Serien lieber im Kino

questions.explain: 'Eine Sendung' is a TV/radio programme (from 'senden', to broadcast).
'Das Rauchen' means 'smoking' (the activity). 'Der Raum' (room) is a near-miss distractor.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I would like to book a double room'?
questions.explain: 'Buchen' = 'to book' and 'ein Doppelzimmer' = 'a double room'; 'Einzelzimmer' (single) and 'absagen' (cancel) are distractors.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'Next year I will travel to Austria' (future)?
options: Nächstes Jahr werde ich nach Österreich reisen
Letztes Jahr bin ich nach Österreich gereist
questions.explain: 'Werde... reisen' is the future tense 'will travel'; with 'nächstes Jahr' (next year) the future is correct.
'Die Fahrkarte' is a travel 'ticket'; 'die Landkarte' = map, 'der Führerschein' = driving licence.
